title: Fenton Office | When to speak and where to talk
titleZh: 芬頓辦公室｜何時當面打斷、在哪裡交談
passage:
A violet marker on a desk means that the person is doing work that should not be interrupted. The time printed below the marker is when they will next read messages. Speak to the person before then only if you need something from them before that time and neither another person nor a shared source can supply it. A deadline on its own does not make a spoken interruption necessary.

Rowan’s marker says 12:00. Avery needs by 11:50 the date that Rowan put into the revised welcome letter, but the final letter is already in the shared folder. Mallory needs Rowan’s recollection of yesterday’s discussion by 12:15; there are no minutes and nobody else heard the part in question. Samir must reply to a caller by 11:55 about where a training group will meet. Rowan moved the group this morning. No one else knows the new room, and the shared room list is still out of date.

For conversations between coworkers, the open corner table is fine for a quick exchange, but move to the enclosed room if you expect anything longer. The small phone booth is for one person, even if the call itself will be brief. These rules apply to people sharing the space, not to the number of callers on a screen.

Dee and Eli had planned to meet at the corner table to confirm one date. Before the meeting, the colleague joining them by video sent them six unresolved matters and wrote, 'Let’s go through these one at a time and discuss the alternatives, rather than just confirming the dates.' Both Dee and Eli will be in the office and need to speak to the colleague from the same location.
passageZh:
桌上放著紫色標記，表示使用者正在做不宜被打斷的工作。標記下方印的是當事人下次查看訊息的時間。只有在你必須在那個時間之前取得回覆，而且沒有其他人或共用資料能提供所需資訊時，才當面打斷對方。只是快到截止時間，並不表示一定要當面打斷。

羅恩的標記寫著 12:00。艾佛里得在 11:50 前知道羅恩寫進新版歡迎信的日期，但定稿已放在共用資料夾。瑪洛里需要在 12:15 前請羅恩回想昨天的討論；沒有會議紀錄，也沒有其他人聽到所問的那一段。薩米爾必須在 11:55 前回電告知上課小組集合地點。羅恩今天早上改了地點。還沒有其他人知道新的集合教室，共用的教室清單也尚未更新。

同事之間若只需簡短交換幾句，可用開放式角落桌；若預期會談得更久，請移到有門的會議室。小電話亭一次只能一人使用，即使通話很短也一樣。規則所指的共用空間者，是現場的人，不包括螢幕上的通話者。

狄和伊萊原本要在角落桌碰面，只確認一個日期。會面前，將透過視訊加入的同事傳來六件尚未解決的事，還寫道：「別只確認日期，我們逐一過一遍，每件都討論其他可行做法。」狄和伊萊都會在辦公室，而且兩人得在同一個地方和那位同事交談。
